Student Attacks KG Classmate, Causing Severe Injuries

An eight-year-old student attacked a six-year-old girl in a classroom, leaving her in serious condition. The incident involved the boy allegedly slamming the girl onto a desk, dragging her, and striking her 12 times with a brick. The victim was admitted to PGI hospital. The attack reportedly occurred when the girl was in KG class and the attacker was in the third grade.
